notes.title: THE BIGGEST UPDATE YET: STORY MODE
notes.notes:
[b]Story mode is almost complete, but keep in mind that everything is subject to change based on feedback, which can be sent to the discord server! [/b]

[b]A non exhaustive list of what has been added:[/b]

-Several 'story levels' that occur on certain nights, allowing you to explore and investigate the mysteries of your surroundings. 

-A massive amount of art and music created for these story levels. 5 new songs and over 15 digital paintings.

- A terrifying new enemy that will show up late in the game.

-a veritable mountain of bug fixes and performance improvements.

- several gameplay tweaks to balance some of the upgrades and playstyles.

- new sound FX have been added, as well as other special FX like screen shake, particle FX, and adaptive lighting!

[b]GamePlay changes[/b]

- Knockback given to enemies is now directional, meaning that the enemy will fly away at an angle measured from the queen, instead of just moving backwards. this also applies to the food they drop!
(NOTE: please be careful not to launch dragonflies directly into the nest, that would not be good)



[b]Balance changes[/b]

- Good Investm-ants upgrade has been toned down to make it less "necessary" for late game play. to compensate, it has been made cheaper.

-ants cost slightly less to hatch

-ant stats scale slightly faster when upgrading, especially their movement speed. 

- Queen base damage has been increased

- enemy spawns have been adjusted for more variety

- dropped food is now up to 3 times bigger if the enemy dies near the edge of the screen

- base amount of food dropped has been increased.

- Game now starts with 0 ants instead of the usual 5.

- explosive waves now propagate lightning fast, it might be broken, but it sure is fun.

- many, many others. 

as with any large update, there are bound to be glaring bugs, typos, crashes, and other unpleasant things. please be patient and make sure to report any bugs you find so that they can be fixed quickly! 

[b]HAVE FUN![/b]
